threads.body: [Config] This makes the stable user-facing selectors `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in` (`database`/`database/dup`) and `general.db.semconv.*` stop affecting behavior in the current 2.33 release. `VERSIONING.md:10-20` permits incompatible configuration changes only in a major release (except names containing `experimental`/`preview` or `otel.javaagent.testing`), and none of these selectors qualify. Preserve the existing database resolution outside v3 preview and defer stable-only behavior there until 3.0.

replies.body: This PR targets `3.0.0-SNAPSHOT`, as recorded in `version.gradle.kts`. This is the major release where the breaking change is intended, not a 2.33 release, so the current resolver behavior is intentional.

threads.body: is this latest dep behavior desired (preserving quotes)? check other instrumentations and specification

replies.body: Yes. The baseline uses Spring Data R2DBC 3.0.0, whose mapping context disables forced quoting. Latest dependencies use 4.1.1, which defaults to quoted identifiers, so the generated SQL contains `"CUSTOMER"`. The [v1.44.0 query-summary guidance](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/blob/v1.44.0/docs/db/database-spans.md#generating-a-summary-of-the-query) explicitly shows quoted targets, and the shared SQL parser used by JDBC/R2DBC preserves them. Keeping the version-specific expectation.
